🧠 Crypto News Brief: Regulatory wins and record ETF inflows powered a mid-week surge — until a hot jobs print cooled momentum into the weekend. Bitcoin holds near $80K as fresh DeFi exploits keep traders on edge. 🏛️ SEC Clears BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP as Digital Commodities The SEC granted accelerated approval to a Nasdaq Texas rule change (Order 34-106268) that formally treats Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and XRP as digital commodities eligible for commodity-based trust shares. The revised framework also lets funds hold up to 15% of net asset value in tokens that don't yet meet listing criteria, opening the door to actively managed, multi-asset crypto products. It's an agency interpretation rather than federal law, but it meaningfully widens the runway for the next wave of ETFs. Read full story 🚀 Waller's Disinflation Signal Sparks a $566M Short Squeeze Dovish comments from Fed Governor Christopher Waller lit a fuse under risk assets, pushing total crypto market cap past $2.71 trillion and forcing a roughly $566 million short squeeze that liquidated more than 105,000 traders in a single day. Altcoins led the charge on the back of the SEC's commodity ruling, with XRP ETFs extending their inflow streak to eleven straight sessions. More details 🏦 Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post Biggest Inflow Since January U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs absorbed roughly $700 million in a single session — their strongest day since January — as prices reclaimed the $80,000 zone and Ether funds added more than $140 million alongside. It's a clear sign institutional appetite is returning, though analysts caution one big day isn't a trend, noting such spikes have occasionally preceded short-term local tops. Read more 🕵️ Privacy Coins Break Out as Zcash and Dash Rip Higher With majors cooling, capital rotated hard into privacy names: Zcash surged around 20% toward $1,023 — up roughly 2,300% year-on-year — while Dash jumped as much as 45% on heavy volume, and Monero and NEAR also outperformed. The move drained short-term speculative flows out of Bitcoin, even as institutional liquidity stayed anchored to BTC. See details 🛡️ Notional Finance V1 Drained for ~$1.7M in Integer-Overflow Exploit An attacker siphoned about $1.73 million in DAI and USDC from a legacy Notional Finance V1 escrow contract, exploiting a flaw that let a massive fabricated debt register as zero.
